forgot.description: Enter the email you used to sign up — we'll send a one-time reset link if the account exists.
forgot.genericError: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
forgot.successBody: If an account exists with that email, a password reset link is on its way. The link is valid for 1 hour and can be used once.
forgot.title: Forgot your password?

login.googleUnavailable: Google sign-in is not available right now. Try again or sign in with email.
login.title: Log in to TradeHub

oauthCallback.existsBodyLogin: Sign in with your password to continue. You can link Google later in Settings → Security.
oauthCallback.existsBodyRegister: Sign in to that account instead of creating a new one.
oauthCallback.existsFor: There is already a TradeHub account for <0>{{email}}</0>.
oauthCallback.existsTitleRegister: You already have a TradeHub account
oauthCallback.noAccountBody: We couldn't find a TradeHub account for this Google identity. Sign up first, then you can use Google to sign in.
oauthCallback.pendingDescription: One moment while we set up your session.
oauthCallback.whyLogin: We never automatically merge accounts based on email — that way nobody can take over your TradeHub account by signing into Google with the same address.
oauthCallback.whyNoSilent: We never silently create accounts when you click "Sign in" — that way you always know when an account is being made for you.
oauthCallback.whyRegister: We never duplicate accounts. If you forgot your password, use "Forgot password" on the sign-in screen.
